criteria.text: Response states the AMZN Q1 FY2024 increase in server useful life from five years to six years is attributed to continuous improvements in hardware, software, and data center designs.

Response states the support shows a shift from improving server longevity in Q1 FY2024 to faster artificial intelligence and machine learning-driven technology turnover in Q1 FY2025.
